title: The pillars of Iman
intro: Six basic truths of faith that we firmly believe and often say.

learn.html: The pillars of Iman are the six basic truths of faith that make up iman – Islamic belief. We firmly believe them and often say them:

learn.ar: وَبِالْقَدَرِ خَيْرِهِ وَشَرِّهِ مِنَ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى
learn.tr: wa bil-qadari khayrihee wa sharrihee minallaahi ta‘aalaa
learn.en: and I believe that everything happens by Allah’s will and decree

practice.title: The pillars of Iman in order
practice.prompt: Put the six pillars of Iman in order.

questions.q: How many pillars of Iman are there?
What is the first pillar of Iman?
What do we do with the pillars of Iman?
options: We firmly believe them and often say them
We say them once a year
